title: Supply Chain Analytics: A Data-Driven Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.10563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern supply chain networks increasingly rely on real-time data to navigate structural uncertainties, market volatility, and operational disruptions. This manuscript bridges the gap between statistical data-driven learning and robust decision-making frameworks in logistics and operations management. We present a comprehensive, mathematically rigorous treatment of supply chain analytics, moving from empirical demand forecasting to optimal inventory and network control under uncertainty. Key topics explored include sample minimization, dynamic programming recursions for time-varying inventory replenishment, network fulfillment frameworks, and advanced distributionally robust optimization (DRO) via transport theory to hedge against rare events. translated_title: 供应链分析：一种数据驱动的方法
translated_abstract: 现代供应链网络日益依赖实时数据来应对结构性不确定性、市场波动和运营中断。本手稿弥合了物流与运营管理领域中统计数据驱动学习与鲁棒决策框架之间的差距。我们提出了一个全面且数学上严谨的供应链分析处理方法，从实证需求预测延伸到不确定性下的最优库存与网络控制。探讨的关键主题包括样本最小化、时变库存补货的动态规划递归、网络履约框架，以及通过传输理论实现的先进分布鲁棒优化（DRO）以对冲罕见事件。通过将预测性统计模型与规范性控制算法（如车辆路径问题的列生成和非齐次排队机制）相结合，本文为……提供了基础。
tldr: 本文提出了一套数学严谨的供应链分析框架，将预测性统计模型与规范性控制算法（包括动态规划库存补货和基于传输理论的分布鲁棒优化）相结合，以实现不确定性下的最优供应链决策。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a mathematically rigorous supply chain analytics framework that integrates predictive statistical models with prescriptive control algorithms—including dynamic programming for inventory replenishment and distributionally robust optimization via transport theory—to enable optimal supply chain decision-making under uncertainty.
